title: 2026 Navier–Stokes similarity observables
description: DERIVED renderer of selected similarity-scale relations from the 2026 forced Navier–Stokes blow-up construction. It is not the full proof object. Source state is frozen bytes (particle scaffold + tau/rs/zs/vel schedule); every genome control is observation-only (camera, tone mapping, sampling, playback). This source exists to exercise provenance discipline until a paper-specific executable adapter replaces it.
core_statement: similarity exponents/relations/scaffold/schedule frozen; observation only evolves

immutable_core.scaffold: 8192-point quasi-random (u, eta, X) base in app/static/data/ns26/base.f32.bin

rotation.provenance: v1 NS26 renderer yaw control; camera only, never source state

pitch.provenance: v1 NS26 renderer pitch control; camera only

zoom.provenance: v1 NS26 renderer zoom; framing only

threshold.provenance: v1 NS26 tone cut on native pulse scalar |pulse|

gamma.provenance: v1 NS26 tone curve on native pulse scalar

exposure.provenance: v1 NS26 alpha gain on native pulse scalar

sample.provenance: fraction of frozen scaffold particles drawn

point_size.provenance: point sprite size; source-native point observer

time_rate.provenance: playback rate over the frozen 120-frame schedule

swirl.provenance: azimuthal observation phase wound by frozen velocity scale; source state untouched

v1_lineage: Observation vocabulary descends from mathartist-v1 src/artists.js NS26_CORE (mutable h/tau/twist/etaFreq). V3 froze all of those into the scaffold/schedule; only camera, tone-mapping, sampling and playback vary. See docs/ARCHIVE_MAP.md.
